revision: candidate-only formatter indexes with complete alias invalidation
reason: The prior implementation completed its fixed final look without clearing all bounds. This study tests a substantive reduction in symbol-index construction; prior failures remain recorded and are not combined across changed binaries.
method: Fixed 768 balanced randomized three-arm rounds, all six permutations per complete six-round block. One final inference; no interim acceptance or automatic repeat.
acceptance: Every original ratio-of-medians CPU/wall comparison AND every simultaneous upper percentile block-bootstrap bound on mean CPU/wall ratios must be <=5%. All complete results retained. No automatic retry.
cpu_selection: Rank physical CPU pairs by minimum sibling idle fraction over five seconds; assign disjoint pairs before sampling, keep every arm of each case on its assigned CPU. Coordinator and inference exclude all assigned pairs.
execution: Shared independent case workers on disjoint physical CPU pairs; no owned builds/tests/corpus during sampling.
shared_scheduler_amendment: All 25 independent cases from the three feature studies may run together on disjoint physical CPU pairs. No samples collected yet; per-feature tests, fixed sample counts, comparison families and acceptance criteria unchanged.
main_amendment: All arms rebuilt after the shared wrap-splitting fix; complete output equivalence and all repository checks pass. Statistical protocol unchanged; no samples from this revision collected yet.
